notes: re-scoped from the shared unit to sysml alone (ADR-0015)
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.21.2. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `ownedRelationship += FeatureChainMember` in both — so there is nothing to weigh. It contributes no tokens: it is the feature reference expression that wraps the subject of a satisfaction, and everything written is the chain below it. Being a FeatureChainMember rather than a plain name is what lets the subject be `vehicle_design.engine_v1` as readily as `vehicle_design`.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.

Line 22 `satisfy vehicleSpecification by vehicle_design;` reaches this production with a single-segment chain; line 23 `satisfy engineSpecification by vehicle_design.engine_v1;` with a two-segment one.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
